evidence_required: All arithmetic shown; a five-row check table (electrical, liquid, CDU, floor, feed loss) with pass or fail marks.

marking.criterion: Item 1, DLC node 9.14 kW AC; 4-node rack 36.75 kW, saving 4.25 kW (10.4 %)
Item 2, 5-node rack 45.89 kW, 50.48 kW per side with margin, fits under 65.55 kW
Item 3, coolant 55.4 L/min, residual air 1,074 CFM, CDU 293.7 kW (97.9 %) fails
Items 4 and 5, floor 1,326 kg/m2 fails; feed loss 9.0 kW against 8.59 kW DC passes (2 points each)
Item 6, verdict of 4 nodes per rack with the floor (and CDU) named as the binding constraint

title: What liquid cooling does to node power and rack density
